description: Generate a multi-slide branded carousel (crisp slide PNGs + optional LinkedIn swipeable PDF documentUrl) from a topic, post copy, source URL, or existing campaign contentId, and optionally attach all slides directly in place to the campaign asset.

contentId.description: Optional existing campaign contentId to attach the rendered slides (and pdfUrl) directly in place

contentText.description: Optional full source text or post copy to turn into slides (auto-extracted from contentId when omitted)

exportPdf.description: Export a swipeable PDF URL ready for LinkedIn native document carousels

topic.description: Topic, angle, or slide design instructions

name: wordflux_generate_carousel
